caveat: All release builds. Cache states normalized (SQLite WALs checkpointed on both engines' disk caches) before the run so neither engine races ahead on stale WAL reads. oden additionally keeps its WALs small automatically at startup (fix shipped this session, verified: 2.4MB WAL folded to 0 bytes on first open). The ~2.5-4ms remaining gap vs deno lives in V8 snapshot deserialization + per-statement SQLite file-size checks + npm resolution. Clean-state pass measured bun/deno/oden (node numbers are in the earlier session data).
